<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (m/z 276.07) and the 13C NMR data (aromatic carbons, a carbonyl at ~166 ppm, an O‑CH2 at ~61 ppm and a methyl at ~14 ppm), the compound is most consistent with an ethyl ester of a phenolic aromatic acid. A reasonable structure that matches these features is ethyl 4‑hydroxybenzoate. Its SMILES representation is:

CCOC(=O)C1=CC=C(C=C1)O

This SMILES string accounts for the observed carbonyl, aromatic carbons, O‑CH2, and methyl signals, and its calculated monoisotopic mass (including the proton) matches the observed m/z.
